title: Quietly Quenched Canadian Tomato Gratin
description: A comforting Canadian dish featuring tinned tomatoes, this quietly quenched gratin is perfect for a chilly evening, cultured and juicy, it is also egg-free-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the crushed tinned tomatoes, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In a small bowl, mix the all-purpose flour and a splash of the tomato mixture to make a slurry, then stir the slurry back into the skillet.
Transfer the tomato mixture to 4 ramekins.
Top each ramekin with shredded grana padano cheese and bread crumbs.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
